5:48 am · offshore wind · A-frame peak

Dawn Patrol

The set is standing up on the peak. Stay ahead of the whitewater, pump for speed, launch off the lip and tuck into the barrel.

  • ControllerPlug in or pair a game controller: stick or D-pad steers, A pumps (and starts), B or a trigger stalls and grabs, Y changes view, Start pauses.
  • On a phoneLeft thumb stick = the arrow keys (diagonals work). Pump = Space, Stall / Grab = Shift. You can also drag a finger on the wave to steer toward it.
  • TakeoffYou drop in at the peak. Press ← or → to go left or right; the wave peels the way you pick.
  • ↑ ↓ rail turnsHold ↑ to aim up the face, ↓ to aim down it: the board rolls onto its rail, arcs round to that line and holds it. Hold longer for a steeper line; add ←/→ for a diagonal. Turns are long arcs at speed and tight when you're slow. ← → point you along the wave either way.
  • Space pumpTap in rhythm to pump down the line. Works best high on the face.
  • Hit the lipBottom turn, then come up the face steep to launch; a shallow line just bounces off the lip and the wave knocks you back down. The faster and steeper you hit it, the bigger the air (a good one is a metre or two over the lip).
  • AirsThe angle and speed you hit the lip decide the air. Keep holding ↑ or ↓ to keep rotating (alley-oop), or spin with ← →. Land nose first or tail first; tap ← or → to revert from fakie.
  • Air tricksShift grabs: alone = Indy, with ↑ = Slob, ↓ = Tail grab, ←/→ = Stalefish. Rodeo flip: grab with Shift, then hold ↑/↓ and ←/→ together. Space in the air for a Christ air: arms out in a cross; it has to finish before you land or you land stiff.
  • SnapCome up the face and press ↓ at the top: the fins let go and the board pivots under your front foot with the tail sliding out over the lip. Tap it for a quick top turn down the line; hold it to snap all the way round, back into the pocket.
  • Lip grindIn a barrel section, ride up onto the pitching lip and slide along the top of it. Press ↓ to drop off the front into the face before the curl catches you.
  • Wave tricksTurn hard off the top at speed and the fins let go a little: the tail skids and sprays (chip the lip). Carve hard low on the face for a bottom turn that fires you up faster. Bury a full-rail carve through the middle of the face = gouge. Ride the top of the breaking part = floater. Turns back into the curl are all yours to time. Shift in a hard turn = layback.
  • RocksCarve round them or air over them. When a barrel section starts the reef drains, then the surge buries it in a boil: hit the boil fast and it launches you.
  • Barrel sectionWhen the wave starts pitching, hold Shift to stall so the lip throws over you. Ride low inside: your rider tucks down small under the lip.
  • C or 1–4Switch view: beach, chase, first person, drone.
